note: DEMO corpus for the retrieval layer. 'verbatim' entries are short quotes read from the vendor page (Sandvik Coromant, Troubleshooting milling, read 13 Oct 2026) or quoted in a search result (Kennametal tech tip); 'paraphrase' entries are my paraphrase of content seen on the page or in a search snippet and must be checked against the source before use. Vendor material is copyrighted: only tiny quotes are kept here.

entries.quote: Try up milling and tighten the feed mechanism (feed screw or ball screw)

entries.source: Sandvik Coromant, Troubleshooting milling, Vibration: cutting data
entries.quote: Adjust cutting speed, feed per tooth or depth of cut

entries.source: Sandvik Coromant, Troubleshooting milling, Vibration in corners
entries.quote: Program large corner radii with reduced feed rate

entries.source: Kennametal tech tip, Reducing chatter and vibration in end milling
entries.quote: Ensure the tool run-out is within acceptable limits.
relations: chatter runout tonal once per revolution

entries.source: Kennametal tech tip, Reducing chatter and vibration in end milling
entries.quote: Make the workpiece as rigid and secure as possible.

entries.source: Kennametal tech tip, Reducing chatter and vibration in end milling
entries.quote: Minimize the distance between the workpiece and spindle.

entries.source: Haas VF-series service manual (archive), isolating vibration
entries.quote: Run each axis with the spindle off, then run the spindle without moving the axes, to find whether the vibration comes from the spindle or an axis
